basics.name: Poojan Palakkumar Shrivastav
basics.label: Full Stack Developer | AI Engineering Student | Product Engineer
basics.summary: Full Stack Developer and Artificial Intelligence student with experience building production web applications, SaaS platforms, and AI integrations. Proficient in React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and cloud services. Demonstrated experience optimizing website performance, developing custom analytics systems, and shipping software for active users.

bullets: Built a first-party analytics system with real client IP geolocation tracking and bot filtering to display accurate user traffic metrics for 2,500+ users.
Developed an IP-based automatic currency switcher to display pricing in INR for users in India and USD for international visitors.
Reduced website payload size by 80% (36 MB to 6.89 MB) by migrating media files from MongoDB Atlas to AWS S3 and CloudFront CDN.
Optimized database queries by requesting only required card fields, resolving admin panel loading delays.
Integrated an AI voice calling feature and configured Nginx proxy settings to enable real-time streaming responses.
Architected and built FormX Consultants (formxconsultants.com), a 40+ page architectural consulting platform using Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Built Navkar Tubes & Tools (navkar-tubes-and-pipes.vercel.app), a web platform for a Jindal steel pipe distributor featuring an interactive pipe weight calculator and backend APIs.
Co-founded studio and shipped Tripzy / Travebie (travebie.com), an AI travel booking platform featuring a 19-intent classification engine and 18 interactive chat cards.
Wrote automated Playwright end-to-end test suites to validate user booking flows and API endpoints.
Configured Progressive Web App (PWA) offline support and developed an administrator mobile app using React Native.
